recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-8143 unless Pharmacy reopens the broader MedicationRequest repeat-count model.
issue_request: FHIR-8143 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 MedicationPrescription.dispense.numberOfRepeatsAllowed and asked whether the value includes the original order dispense. The accepted resolution changed the definition to additional repeats/refills only, explicitly excluding the original order dispense and giving the 30 tablets plus 3 repeats equals 4 total dispenses example.
initial_application: Git-svn commit d6a8c1cff53246b94cce2d0ba943b68db8e20b0a applied #8143 to the then-current MedicationOrder spreadsheet. MedicationPrescription had been renamed to MedicationOrder, and commit 7387b2894c026dce7c36229cd84b90e883d6e5cb later renamed the source lineage to active MedicationRequest.
additional_context: FHIR-10096 later corrected the same element's display comment, FHIR-13182 later changed the datatype to unsignedInt and added zero-refill guidance, and FHIR-14565 later declined renaming the element. MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and no Zulip or Confluence record found for FHIR-8143 changed the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml already carries the additional-only definition, original-dispense exclusion, total-dispense example, and aligned comment.

Later MedicationDispense.fillNumber clarification confirms MedicationRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed assumes full fills.
